hints.title: Net Debts Consolidation
hints.text: Compute each person net balance. Only individuals with non-zero balances need to settle debts among opposite balance signs.

hints.title: Zero Balance Pairing Optimization
hints.text: When debts[start] and debts[i] sum to exactly zero, pairing them immediately reduces the transaction count optimally.

hints.title: Branch-and-Bound Debt Transfer
hints.text: Recursively settle the first non-zero balance by testing transfers with every remaining person of opposite sign. Add current debt to debts[i], explore deeper, and backtrack.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of people with non-zero balance (<= 12)
complexity.notes: Branch and bound search over debt clearing partitions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy heuristic matching fails to find the global minimum transaction count on cyclic dependencies.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Exact zero-sum pair pruning cuts recursive factorial exploration dramatically.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Aggregate net balances first and apply pruned recursive search.
